Making small changes

18 Aug 2019

I’ve just finished reading James Clear’s book, Atomic Habits, and I found it quite brilliant. One of its biggest lessons is the power of small changes and how they compound over time. I’m paraphrasing here:

You get what you repeat. Time will magnify it.

I love this idea. It’s one more thing I’m going to be deliberate about in my workflow.

I wrote so many notes on this book, it almost felt like I was quoting every sentence! No matter, I will go through the notes and post my full review on Saccader.
